mechanism_narrative: A renewed decline in WORKPLACES to -37.1% signals tightening workplace mobility restrictions that reduce weekday footfall and drag RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds its last 28-day mean while WORKPLACES remains below -35%.

mechanism_narrative: A RESIDENTIAL weekly mean above 11.5% indicates sustained stay-at-home behavior that suppresses non-essential retail trips, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days after RESIDENTIAL exceeds 11.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The divergence of rising PARKS (-3.7) and falling TRANSIT (-40.1) reflects substitution from transit commuting to localized outdoor trips, which lifts retail-and-recreation footfall in open commercial areas and raises RETAIL_REC.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC falls over the next 28 days when PARKS > -10 and TRANSIT < -35.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime (WORKPLACES < -35, RESIDENTIAL > 11), GROCERY_PHARM staying below -8 signals that only essential errands persist, leaving discretionary retail weak and pushing RETAIL_REC lower.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES < -35 and RESIDENTIAL > 11.

mechanism_narrative: A PARKS weekly mean above -10 signals consumers are re-engaging with outdoor recreation, which spills over into adjacent retail-and-recreation venues and raises RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next week after PARKS exceeds -10.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal October cooling reduces PARKS mobility; a drop in PARKS below -15 removes an outdoor alternative and reduces retail trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks when PARKS falls below -15.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT below -40 and WORKPLACES below -35 jointly indicate a contraction in commuting and office activity that removes lunchtime and after-work retail demand, so RETAIL_REC declines over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days when TRANSIT < -40 and WORKPLACES < -35.

mechanism_narrative: Essential-only shopping behavior, marked by GROCERY_PHARM above -8 while WORKPLACES stays below -35, means discretionary retail trips are not recovering, so RETAIL_REC declines over two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days when GROCERY_PHARM > -8 and WORKPLACES < -35.
